card.name: Digits inside US election years
card.fires_on: The third digit of a four-digit year, such as the 0 in 2004 or 2008 or the 6 in 1960 or 1860, in talk of US presidential elections and voting.

modes.label: Election year digit
modes.description: The third digit of a year like 2004, 2008, 2000, 1960 or 1860 in text about presidential votes.

modes.label: Other number digits
modes.description: A digit inside a decimal or a long number outside any election context.

card.writes: It prepares the model to finish the year with its last digit, such as 4 or 8, not clearly shown by the listed tokens.
card.plain: It lights up on the middle digits of election years like 2004 or 2008 while the year is still being written out.
